Key Takeaways
The team plans to review all marketing activities for January, focusing on BTL marketing, social media, paid marketing, and influencer marketing, with a specific emphasis on Instagram.
A pilot campaign was conducted with two cohorts: known customers and new users, with ads shown to one group and not the other, to analyze behavioral differences.

There was a discussion on the effectiveness of the campaign, with a noted 10% increase in unique purchases for the cohort shown ads, but concerns about a potential mismatch between promises and delivery.
The team decided to continue with the same cohorts for another week to gather more data, without location targeting, and to focus on digital paid ads for cohort B.
Influencer marketing is being prioritized, with plans to provide influencers with gold memberships to enhance their experience and advocacy, and a focus on creating engaging content.
Social Media and Influencer Marketing
Evaluation of marketing strategies involving digital campaigns, influencer content, BTL marketing, focusing on increasing brand awareness, store visits.
Unexpected decline in sales observed post-marketing campaigns, indicating potential issues with campaign effectiveness.
Influencer content not resonating well with audiences, leading to lower engagement than expected.
Test different cohort strategies to evaluate the impact of ads on customer behavior, including targeting gold, non-gold members, and new customers.
Increase quality, engagement of creative content to improve campaign outcomes.

Conduct regular reviews of marketing budgets and strategies to ensure cost-effectiveness.
Budget constraints affecting ability to reach target audiences effectively.

Campaign Adjustments and Monitoring
Adjust cohort strategies enhance campaign performance monitoring ensure more reliable data collection.
Difficulty assessing campaign effectiveness due to external factors, inconsistent data, leading to unclear results.
Adjustment of marketing campaigns based on performance feedback, aiming for improved outcomes and strategic alignment.
Marketing Campaign Performance
Potential mismatch between campaign promises and in-store experiences leading to decreased conversions.
Initial marketing campaigns showed negative correlation with sales, questioning effectiveness.
Continue evaluating campaign strategies, considering external factors and different customer cohorts for better insights.
Improve tracking, reporting of campaign performance metrics for more accurate assessments.
Analysis of campaign performance, focus on return on investment, effectiveness of strategies in driving sales, engagement.
Store Location Links and Accessibility
Enhancing store accessibility through digital platforms, improving customer experience, information availability.
Update store location links across platforms for improved accessibility, customer satisfaction.
Existing issues with store location links affecting customer experience and campaign effectiveness, potentially leading to customer confusion.
Google Ads and Billing
Resolve outstanding billing, access issues with Google to facilitate campaign execution, ensure compliance.
Ongoing issues with Google Ads account access, unresolved billing complications, impacting campaign execution.
Management of Google Ads campaigns, addressing billing and access issues for seamless operations.
Content Quality and Strategy
Ensure consistency in brand messaging and improve collaboration with influencers for better content quality and engagement.
Concerns about quality, consistency of creative content, potentially affecting brand image, campaign effectiveness.
Focus on creating high-quality, engaging content for marketing campaigns to enhance brand perception, customer engagement.
